title: Octopus arm reaction speed vs how long a severed arm keeps reacting

source.name: Octopus arm autonomy studies (as reported)
source.publisher: Research coverage of severed-arm reflex studies

notes: A pinched arm recoils within about 1 second. Separately, researchers found a fully severed arm keeps reacting to touch and pain for up to an hour (3,600 seconds) with no brain attached at all.

points.label: How fast an arm reacts to a pinch
